messages:
leo_sales: Heads-up — Northpoint Medical SIG deadlines moved up. They need completed Q3 (data-in-transit), Q8 (key custody), and Q19 (subprocessor controls) by COB tomorrow. Can SE + InfoSec assemble evidence?
tara_se: I can gather TLS config, cipher lists, and load balancer cert rotation notes. I’ll also export the network diagram showing private endpoints. @rachel_infosec can you confirm key custody options?
rachel_infosec: Confirming. For Private/VPC customers we support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and HSM attestations for dedicated appliances. We have an HSM-attest-2025.pdf and byok-process-2026.md. Need to know what Northpoint requested exactly (BYOK vs Redwood-managed?).
leo_sales: They prefer BYOK + HSM attestation if possible. Also asked for proof we redact PHI from logs.
maria_cs: We have redaction-policy.pdf and the log-scrubber-runbook.md. Note: scrubber is applied before any artifact sharing. I’ll prepare a redacted sample log excerpt for review.
tara_se: Uploading TLS and network artifacts now to secure artifacts path and setting share to northpoint-security@northpointmed.com
ops-bot: upload: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/tls-config-2026-03.txt (owner: tara_se)
ops-bot: upload: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/lb-cert-rotation-2025.pdf (owner: tara_se)
ops-bot: upload: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/private-network-diagram-2026.png (owner: tara_se)
tara_se: Also adding the cipher-suite matrix and a snippet of the nginx config showing TLS1.2+ enforced.
rachel_infosec: I pulled HSM attestation and BYOK flow docs. Uploaded: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/hsm-attest-2025.pdf and https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/byok-process-2026.md
rachel_infosec: Important: for Q8 (key custody) include a short one-paragraph statement about who holds key material in Private deployments and reference the byok-process doc. I’ll draft that statement.
maria_cs: Redacted log excerpt ready (sample-no-pii.log). Uploaded: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/sample-no-pii.log. I removed IPs and any PHI per redaction_policy_v2.pdf.
leo_sales: Can we produce a concise question->artifact mapping (one-pager)? Northpoint security asked for it inside the SIG portal to speed reviewers.
tara_se: I can make a SIG mapping CSV with columns: question, artifact_url, page/section. Will export as sig-map-northpoint-2026.csv and set ACL.
ops-bot: upload: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/sig-map-northpoint-2026.csv (owner: tara_se)
rachel_infosec: Quick check: Q19 asks about subprocessors and subcontractor assessments. We need the latest subprocessor roster + the risk assessment summary for any critical vendor. I uploaded subprocs-2026-03.csv and vendor-risk-summary-critical.pdf
ops-bot: upload: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/subprocs-2026-03.csv
ops-bot: upload: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/vendor-risk-summary-critical.pdf
leo_sales: Excellent. One ask from Northpoint: include a redacted SOC2 or eigen-scan snapshot. We can include a SOC2-excerpt (public) and vulnerability-scan snapshot.
ops-bot: upload: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/soc2-excerpt-redacted-2025.pdf
ops-bot: vulnerability-scan: model-serving/2026-03-18 -> findings: 0 critical, 1 high, 3 medium. Report: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/vuln-report-2026-03-18.pdf
maria_cs: I verified that the vuln report contains no customer data and added a short signed note: "No PHI/PII included". Uploaded signature: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/no-pii-statement-signed.txt
rachel_infosec: Drafted key-custody statement: "For Northpoint Private deployments, key material remains under customer control when BYOK is selected. Redwood holds encrypted key blobs and supports HSM-backed import/export attestations. See byok-process-2026.md and hsm-attest-2025.pdf for details." Uploaded key-custody-statement-2026.txt
ops-bot: upload: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/key-custody-statement-2026.txt (owner: rachel_infosec)
tara_se: Assembling final bundle: northpoint-sig-evidence-bundle-2026.zip (redacted, signed). ETA 90 minutes. Will include the SIG map, SOC2 excerpt, HSM attestation, redaction statement, subprocessor list, and TLS/network artifacts.
leo_sales: Perfect. Once bundle is up, I’ll submit via their SIG portal and email the security contact. If they ask for live demo of BYOK import flow we may need an SE-run session.
maria_cs: Copying the customer success owner for Northpoint and preparing a short explainer email template.
rachel_infosec: One more item — include the CloudTrail snippet proving KMS rotation for the alias alias/redwood-northpoint-prod (last rotated 2026-01-05). I uploaded cloudtrail-kms-snippet-2026.json to artifacts.
ops-bot: upload: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/cloudtrail-kms-snippet-2026.json
tara_se: Received. I’ll add it to the bundle.
ops-bot: access-log: northpoint-sig-evidence-bundle-2026.zip created by tara_se at 1799556800 (permissions: northpoint-security@northpointmed.com)
leo_sales: Submitted bundle into Northpoint SIG portal and emailed security@northpointmed.com. They replied acknowledging receipt and asking for the SIG map to include page numbers inside the HSM attestation.
tara_se: I’ll update the SIG map file with page refs into the HSM attestation and re-upload.
ops-bot: upload: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/northpoint/sig/sig-map-northpoint-2026-v2.csv (owner: tara_se)
leo_sales: Closing thread — handed to sales follow-up for any clarifying Qs. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
